description:
Restructure your Zotero library by separating historical papers from modern ones.

1. Identify all papers in your library published BEFORE 1970.
2. Add the tag 'classic-era' (exact spelling, all lowercase) to these pre-1970 items.
3. Create a new collection named 'History of Computing'.
4. Add all the identified pre-1970 papers to this 'History of Computing' collection.

Do NOT tag or add any papers published in 1970 or later.

Your library has been pre-loaded with a mix of classic CS/physics papers (1900s-1960s) and modern machine learning papers (2010s-2020s).
